note: R31's decomposition on the relinked build. The frame period is quantised to whole 60 Hz vblanks: frame_min_ms 49.976 at the start map and 33.292 at E1M1 against 16.6831 measured ms a vblank. submit_ms is 0.169 ms a step, so gpu_ms is marker-poll granularity rather than GPU execution, and a present waits exactly one vblank and never zero. The application's own CPU is 21.7 ms a frame at BOTH maps while the driver's queue cost differs threefold between them, which makes it the largest remaining cost and scene-independent. Runs 10-13% slower than the baseline until R31's summary was changed from one fprintf per field to one write.
